A_scale_transfer.question: Does the decision hold when the scale S is fit on one camera state and applied to the other?
A_scale_transfer.data: stored features of the five field-adapted detectors (run_extension_v5.hole_pool, integer peaks); five-fold partition of snapshot v1; no detector is run
A_scale_transfer.forward_primary: for each fold k: S = door8.geometry.fit_scale(TRAIN sessions of fold k in state normal, features, cad, 'pixel'); TEST frames of fold k in state changed are judged with door8.geometry.classify_measurement (8 CAD values, geometry gate, 30 mm reject) and the session vote run_extension_v5.vote; pooled over the five folds (201 doors)
A_scale_transfer.reverse_secondary: the same with S fit on the TRAIN sessions in state changed and applied to the TEST frames in state normal (160 doors)
A_scale_transfer.depth_secondary: forward and reverse repeated with mode 'depth' (depth-plane distance with its scale fit on one state only)
A_scale_transfer.reference: the stored decisions with S fit on all TRAIN sessions, restricted to the same doors
A_scale_transfer.metrics: doors and frames correct / rejected / wrong; relative residual to the CAD value of the true class (median, minimum, maximum, RMS); margin utilisation U as in run_extension_v12.residual_stats with run_extension_v5.bands; S per fold; results for the two bumped sessions listed separately
A_scale_transfer.limit_to_state: the detectors were adapted and selected with field images of both camera states; the number of annotated field images per state and role is reported (C5). Only S is restricted to one state.

B_in_list_input_errors.question: How do the manuscript's own models, and the CNNs that do not use D, classify the five excluded sessions whose operator input was another class of the selection list?
B_in_list_input_errors.images: every rgb_*.png (with its depth_*.png) in the local collection folder of the session, as for the E23 sessions of extension_v3 (run_extension_v3.e23_rows pattern)
B_in_list_input_errors.hole: fold-0 field-adapted detector holes_field8_f0_s42_v2; features by run_extension_v3.extract; S = fit_scale(fold-0 TRAIN sessions, development feature pool, 'pixel') as in the main fold-0 evaluation; classify_measurement with the 8 CAD values; session = run_extension_v3.session_outcome
B_in_list_input_errors.cnn: rgb_f0_s42 and rgbe_f0_s42 (8 outputs); closed-set argmax per image by door8 cnn_predict, session = mode (run_extension_v3.session_outcome). No rejection threshold is applied. None of the five sessions was in any training, validation or test split.
B_in_list_input_errors.report: per session: number of images, measured D (median), decision of the hole method, decisions of the two CNNs, and whether each equals the operator input or the corrected label. The bound for the manuscript is stated as found: if the hole method disagrees with the operator input in m of the five sessions, the door accuracy under the assumption that those operator inputs were right is 361 / (361 + m).

C_retabulations.C5: annotated field images (field40 label set) by camera state and by role in each fold

rules: Nothing existing is overwritten; outputs go to reports/extension_v15/. All results are reported whatever the direction. No threshold, rule or metric is changed after seeing the outputs. A technical failure is fixed without changing the analysis, re-run, and noted in reports/extension_v15/run_notes.json.
